d=json.load(sys.stdin)

input.subject: Update — Tanya Mitchell (Unit 14, 1402 Rimrock Dr): Balance, Eviction Filing, and Unit Status
input.body:
Dear Ms. Castillo,

I want to give you a clear, current picture on the Tanya Mitchell matter at Unit 14, 1402 Rimrock Drive as we move the file forward.

OUTSTANDING BALANCE
Ms. Mitchell's verified outstanding balance is $2,287.50, made up of:
  • $1,125.00 — carried-forward rent arrears from May
  • $975.00 — June rent
  • $187.50 — late fees assessed through the June 29 cure deadline
This figure already reflects credit for the payments she made under the payment plan before it was breached; $2,287.50 is the net amount that remains owed.

EVICTION STATUS
  • A first late-rent notice was issued June 6, and a payment plan was signed June 11.
  • Ms. Mitchell missed the June 23 installment, breaching the plan.
  • A statutory 3-day notice to pay or vacate was served June 26 and expired uncured on June 29, with no payment or contact from her.
  • With your written authorization received June 30 (thank you), we are filing the forcible-detainer (eviction) petition with the Justice of the Peace court today.
  • Once the petition is filed, the court will set a hearing date, which I will confirm to you as soon as it is scheduled. To be precise: we have not yet had a hearing — filing the petition is the current step.

UNIT STATUS / MAKE-READY
The unit cannot be turned or marketed yet. Ms. Mitchell remains in possession, and until the court grants judgment and possession is lawfully returned to us, no make-ready work or marketing can begin. I have placed the make-ready turn on hold and will mobilize our crew the moment we are legally cleared, to keep any vacancy period as short as possible.

I will keep you posted at each step. Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Patricia Nguyen
Property Manager, Star Property Management

content.text:
Here's the full picture, Patricia — checked against the source systems, not memory.

## 1. What Tanya genuinely owes: **$2,287.50**

Walked back to the underlying charges on the consolidated filing ledger (QB invoice #7214, the one Teresa compiled for the package):

| Component | Amount |
|---|---|
| Carried-forward May rent arrears | $1,125.00 |
| June rent | $975.00 |
| Late fees (through the June 29 cure deadline) | $187.50 |
| **Clean outstanding balance** | **$2,287.50** |

**This is the number that does *not* double-count anything.** Two traps to avoid, and you were right to check:
- The invoice's stated **total of $8,173.44 is wrong** — it lists the "$5,885.94 partial payment-plan credit" as a *positive charge line* instead of a credit. Citing that total would massively overstate what she owes.
- QuickBooks' **customer-balance report shows $0.00** for her — the opposite error, an artifact of that mis-entered credit. Anyone who pulled the QB balance would wrongly conclude she's square.
- On your assumption: the back rent was **partly** paid down (she did pay ~$5,885.94 under the plan), but it was **not** "mostly squared away" — the May arrears, all of June, and late fees remain. She is genuinely delinquent at **$2,287.50**.

**Flag for the file:** ask Teresa/Linda-side accounting to correct invoice #7214 (credit mis-signed; balance shows $0.00) before it goes into the court package, so the ledger you submit is internally clean.

## 2. Where the eviction actually stands — you're a stage *behind* where you remembered

You thought "about at the hearing stage." Reality: we are at the **filing** stage, and the petition is **not yet filed**.
- First late notice 6/6 → payment plan signed 6/11 → **she breached it** (missed 6/23) → 3-day notice served 6/26 → **expired uncured 6/29** (no payment, no contact).
- **The forcible-detainer petition is being filed today (7/1) — there's a JP Court filing appointment at 4:30 PM on your calendar.** As of now it is **not filed**, and **no hearing date exists** (a hearing only gets set after filing).
- The "hearing already set / ready for a favorable ruling" note you're remembering is the **stale OPS-32 thread from May** — it was overtaken by the payment plan and the fresh 3-day cycle. Don't rely on it.

**Owner authorization — yes, it's on file, and it's proper:** Linda Castillo (the property owner) gave written authorization to file on **June 30** by email, cc'd to the team and the JP clerk.

⚠️ **One thing that's off and needs your attention:** OPS-32 is titled **"Harris Property / Harry Harris,"** but every current record for this Unit 14 / 1402 Rimrock Dr matter — the courtesy notices, the authorization, the Airtable eviction record — names **Linda Castillo** as the owner. Harry Harris is a *separate* owner in our directory. Make sure the **court file and owner comms say Castillo, not Harris.** I flagged this on the ticket. (Separately, the unit is labeled inconsistently across old records — 4B / 214 / 14 — but the court-facing designation of record is **Unit 14, 1402 Rimrock Dr**.)

## 3. Can we release the unit for make-ready? **No — it must HOLD.**
She's still in possession. No judgment, no writ, petition not even filed. Under Texas law (and per Brooke's own instruction) **no make-ready work and no marketing** until the court grants possession and we complete a lawful lockout. Turning or listing it now would be premature.

## What I updated for you
- **Airtable make-ready record (Unit 14):** rewrote the stale "mobilize immediately" note to a clear **HOLD — do not mobilize** with the true current facts. *Note: there are several duplicate/conflated make-ready records for this same tenancy (4B / Rio Bend 214 / "Eviction Track" / "Delinquency Escalation") — I recommend consolidating to one to prevent exactly the crew confusion you're worried about.*
- **Eviction ticket (Linear OPS-32):** added a dated note bringing the trail current (timeline, filing-not-hearing, $2,287.50, QB caveat, HOLD, and the Harris/Castillo discrepancy).
- **#make-ready Slack:** posted the HOLD heads-up so the crew doesn't touch or market it.
- **Owner email:** drafted (**not sent**) to Linda Castillo, cc Brooke and Teresa, covering the balance, the filing status, and the make-ready hold. It's in your Drafts for review.

Want me to also correct/consolidate the duplicate make-ready records, or leave that to you?
